briefings.title: How Bots, Deepfakes and AI Agents Are Forcing a New Internet Identity Layer | Alex Blania on a16z

people.name: Alex Blania
people.role: Cofounder and CEO, Tools for Humanity and World

briefings.tldr: As AI agents and deepfakes become indistinguishable from humans, World (formerly Worldcoin) is establishing a global identity layer using iris biometrics and privacy-preserving cryptography to verify "proof of human" uniqueness without compromising individual anonymity.
